noise-floor fail multiplier (10x) calibrated on injected defects and held-out historical cases; pass band (2x) kept by decision (docs/calibration.md)
noise floor sampled with the oracle's own float32 maths in the batchings the trainers use (padded, unpadded, one batch) and over several CPU thread counts
update checked as the accumulated gradient handed to the optimizer (plain SGD, no clipping); optimizer maths itself not tested

TRL's chunked log-prob kernel computes in float32 whatever the model dtype; the floor does not use the library's own code, so the kernel's rounding can still put an accumulated update near the pass band, where it reads as unknown (docs/calibration.md)
